summary.rule: From day -1 through tournament end inspect every official singles qualifying, main-draw and round-robin group phase. A player found in any compiled phase stays permanently without an acceptance label. Absence from qualifying alone never removes the player. Removal requires a compiled final singles phase (main draw or groups), no player occurrence in any compiled phase, and no relevant phase still empty, bye-only, missing or unreadable.
